headline: Gary Black: SpaceX can't afford to buy Tesla — 'the math won't pass muster'; SPCX trading at ~$132 (below $135 IPO price) with further -1.82% premarket decline July 17; an equity-funded acquisition would dilute SPCX shareholders ~25%; Black: Musk's 82% voting control does not override board fiduciary duty to SpaceX shareholders; TSLA slipped 1% Thursday to $391.06 (2nd consecutive red session); Chamath Palihapitiya, Jefferies, and JPMorgan still argue strategic logic holds; Q2 EPS consensus $0.32 expected Jul 22 (Stocktwits / X, Jul 17, 2026)

Electrek: Tesla shareholders begging Musk to explain missed goals ahead of Jul 22 Q2 earnings — most-upvoted Q&A portal questions demand Musk account for why Tesla has missed its own short-term targets 3 earnings in a row on robotaxi, FSD, and Optimus; tone shifted from 'when will the vision arrive?' to 'why aren't stated targets being met?'; Electrek calls it 'a bleak story' for retail investors promised commercial robotaxi scale by mid-2026 (Electrek, Jul 16, 2026)

notateslaapp Q2 earnings call preview: production-ready Optimus Gen 3 prototype reveal imminent — shareholders expect Optimus Gen 3 public unveil, first official unit production count, AI chip roadmap update (AI5 engineering samples, AI6 tapeout timeline), and TERAFAB progress milestone at Jul 22 call; Optimus production line confirmed installed at Fremont July 14; Musk's prior 'late July or August' start commitment now directly testable against earnings disclosure (notateslaapp, Jul 16, 2026)

NTSB exonerates Tesla FSD in fatal Texas house crash — driver at fault, not autonomy system; findings confirm FSD disengaged seconds before impact as driver failed to respond; confirms pattern of driver-error misattribution to Tesla's AI stack; bullish for FSD regulatory narrative heading into Jul 22 Q2 earnings (Teslarati, Jul 16, 2026)

Tesla opens Q2 2026 earnings call Q&A portal ahead of July 22 report — shareholders pressing for robotaxi expansion milestones, first Optimus production unit count, Cybercab fleet targets and paid-ride revenue, unsupervised FSD point-to-point summon ETA, and whether Elon pay package milestones will be met before any merger/acquisition; options market still pricing 7.6% move either direction (Drive Tesla Canada / Benzinga, Jul 16, 2026)

TSLA eyes third consecutive weekly loss (-3%+ WTD) as retail investors grill Musk on missed robotaxi targets — top Say Technologies questions ahead of Jul 22 Q2 earnings: 'Why has Tesla missed short-term robotaxi guidance 3 earnings in a row?' and 'When will Cybercab start customer rides?'; investors demanding concrete fleet size, paid rides, intervention rates, cost per mile, and revenue contribution instead of broader progress updates; Koyfin projects Q2 revenue +17% YoY, adjusted EPS +31% YoY; TSLA closed Thursday at $391.06 (-1.0%) as pre-earnings positioning weighs on stock (Stocktwits / Yahoo Finance, Jul 16, 2026)

Tesla Q2 2026 energy deployment: 13.5 GWh (+53% QoQ) — record Q2 in company history, confirms Q1 8.8 GWh miss was timing not demand — at Q2 run-rate Tesla tracking toward ~54 GWh full-year 2026 vs ~48 GWh consensus; energy gross margins to be revealed Jul 22; energy recovery removes key bear narrative from Q1 and directly supports $10B+ energy revenue thesis for full-year 2026 (teslaoracle.com / Tesla IR, Jul 15, 2026)

FSD v14.3.5 new features confirmed (build 2026.20.6.6): blind spot warnings expanded to new Model Y, 2021+ Model S, and 2021+ Model X; dashcam clip encryption added for all USB-stored footage and Sentry Mode files; camera preview accessible any time; live FSD status in Tesla app; early testers report strong performance across complex real-world routes (notateslaapp / Teslarati, Jul 14-15, 2026)

Wells Fargo raises TSLA PT to $130 from $125, still implies 67% downside — analyst Colin Langan lifted price target on July 14 but maintained Underweight; at ~$391 current price, $130 target implies ~67% decline; bear case: stock prices in a future Tesla has not yet delivered, negative FCF, and $25B capex cycle with uncertain payback; joins JPMorgan and GLJ Research as structural bears heading into July 22 Q2 earnings (Wells Fargo / Yahoo Finance, Jul 14-15, 2026)

Tesla Robotaxi fleet near-flawless in new NHTSA safety report (Apr 15–Jun 16) — Tesla logged only 1 incident in 62 days of unsupervised Austin operation: a zero-fault event where a stationary Robotaxi obeying a red arrow signal was rear-ended by a human-driven pickup truck; Zoox logged +6 incidents, Waymo +191 in the same period; strongest safety data point yet heading into Jul 22 Q2 earnings (notateslaapp / NHTSA filings, Jul 13, 2026)
